original_test_intent: Verify the full OSFP sensor set for every applicable populated cage/module/port, ensuring names, descriptions, readings and states match the specification across in-band SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: Bind chassis, BMC, OSFP cages, installed modules and ports; retain complete unfiltered IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List inventories at aligned times; use an owner-approved cage/module-to-record map to select OSFP entries; capture every Web page; normalize temperature, voltage, optical/presence/link or other defined sensor semantics and compare each required member to the spec while preserving link/thermal/log context.
manual_activity: The network/platform owner supplies the cage/module/port population and OSFP sensor spec and resolves whether criteria 3–12 are missing; an operator verifies complete Web rows and module identities, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/OSFP cage, port, module part/serial/firmware and link identities
Installed-versus-empty cage applicability and authoritative OSFP sensor specification
Per-member mapping among physical cage/module/port, SDR record, IB/OOB Sensor List and Web row
Expected sensor type, unit, normal range/state, thresholds, absent/unavailable/stale semantics and update period
Approved secure IB/OOB collection and complete Web capture path
Sampling, cache, rounding and pagination policy plus normal workload/ambient context
Decision on missing criteria numbers 3 through 12
Link/thermal abort limits, retained-log policy and escalation owner
safety_requirements: Keep the test passive; do not remove modules, disable ports, change optical state or alter sensor/threshold policy
Use approved secret handling and never expose BMC credentials in output or screenshots
Retain complete inventories before OSFP filtering and enumerate every applicable cage/module separately
Do not accept the test title as a literal SDR name or truncate at 100 lines
Preserve logs and link/thermal alarms; do not auto-clear them
Stop on identity ambiguity, missing/duplicate sensor, malformed/stale value, module/link alarm or thermal excursion
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and collect complete read-only IB/OOB sensor inventories
Normalize per-member sensor type, units, readings, status and thresholds and prepare complete Web comparison
Correlate passive link/module/thermal health and preserve discrepancies
Perform no module manipulation, port action, threshold write, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve installed OSFP population, physical-to-sensor mapping, semantics, expected ranges/states and freshness
Resolve the criteria-number gap and any omitted OSFP coverage
Review all populated/required members and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only ipmitool is usable, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - OSFP'` invents a target; OOB-only and `head -100` omit source-required IB, population completeness and Web evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through secure approved access, retain complete IB and OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs, map all applicable OSFP records by cage/module/port and reconcile each with full BMC-Web evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, OSFP filter, Web view, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; log clearing is not automated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join physical OSFP population to stable SDR/Web identities and generate a per-cage/module matrix at aligned timestamps with passive link and thermal context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact module identity, population completeness, typed sensor semantics and link/thermal context without adding active stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single reading cannot prove all populated cages, empty-cage behavior, Web pagination or multi-field parity; OSFP names alone may also conflate cage, port and module sensors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry may disappear for absent or powered-down modules and may be cached differently across surfaces; expected behavior must be explicitly mapped by population and state.

project_override_considerations: Empty cages may be N/A, absent or expose platform sensors only if the approved spec says so. Renamed records require a versioned crosswalk, and no active module/link disturbance is implied by this passive row.
expected_evidence: Full OSFP cage/port/module population with part/serial/firmware/link state and versioned sensor spec
Complete redacted raw IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps and exits
Complete BMC-Web sensor pages with module/population identity
Passive link/thermal/log context, decision for criteria 3–12, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master criteria jump from 2 to 13, and DeepSeek substitutes a title-based sensor while omitting complete IB/Web and per-module evidence. Known OSFP coverage is preserved and the undefined criteria are escalated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive OSFP sensor-reconciliation objective is clear. Module topology/specification and criteria clarification are supplyable project inputs, so the case is not intrinsically blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2013 Wistron-BMC-01033-V002: confirm whether Criteria numbering 1, 2, 13 is only a numbering typo or whether OSFP Criteria 3–12 are missing; if missing, provide exact per-cage/module/port coverage, sensor types/values and IB/OOB/Web acceptance mapping.

review_improvement: Converts the generic OSFP filter into a per-populated-module completeness matrix, preserves all three source views and exposes the criteria gap instead of accepting a single fabricated sensor query.
independent_technical_reasoning: OSFP telemetry may represent cage temperature, module temperature, voltage, optical lanes, presence or link state, and applicability changes with module population. Therefore a name match without physical cage/module binding can compare the wrong object. Complete inventories and a population map are required to detect missing or duplicate members. The unexplained jump to criterion 13 prevents safe inference about potentially omitted OSFP checks.
